read.thesis: Munitions capacity ramp is supply-side driven: MFC sales up 24% with 2026 guidance raised, $8B investment through 2030, and seven-year PAC-3 and THAAD contracts; PAC-3 backlog $52.5B tied to the award.

capex.quote: full-year 2026 target of $2.1 billion to $2.3 billion

triggers.label: MFC sales up 24%, 2026 guide raised
triggers.quote: Sales and profit were both up 24% year-over-year in the quarter, supporting another raise to our full year outlook.

triggers.label: FY26 sales guide raised to $80-82B
triggers.quote: We now expect sales of between $80 billion-$82 billion, up from our previous range

triggers.label: Munitions HOA pricing and cash neutrality unresolved
triggers.quote: What is left to work is the finalization on the profit terms and on the schedule itself

triggers.label: Backlog $292B, book-to-bill 4x
triggers.quote: We ended the quarter with a record backlog of $292 billion

guidance.quote: We now expect sales of between $80 billion-$82 billion, up from our previous range
We expect segment operating profit of between $8.575 billion and $8.675 billion, also up from the prior outlook.
free cash flow between $7.8 billion and $8 billion
We now anticipate cash from operations between $10 billion and $10.2 billion
slightly lower than our July guidance, driven by revised contract award timing expectations for the next lots of F-35
MFC's sales range is increased to between $17.25 billion and $17.45 billion
We expect RMS 2026 sales to finish between $17.7 billion and $18 billion
We anticipate 2026 sales in our space segment will grow between 7% and 8% year-over-year to between $13.95 billion and $14.05 billion.
we see clear line of sight to high single-digit revenue growth next year as a company
we have talked about a pension contribution in excess of $1 billion to be required next year

red_flags.label: Government funding risk on F-35 Lot 20 advance costs
red_flags.quote: Without additional contractual authorization and funding from the U.S. Government, the company's results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition will be negatively impacted in future periods

red_flags.label: Munitions HOA profit and schedule terms not finalised
red_flags.quote: What is left to work is the finalization on the profit terms and on the schedule itself

evasions.quote: we are not giving specific guidance for the following year. We will do that in January.
What is left to work is the finalization on the profit terms and on the schedule itself
